description: RDS license servers by domain (MSSQL) mapped to network zones (MySQL) via IP/subnet containment. Replace placeholder table/column names before use. See companion README.md.

options.content:
### RDS License Servers → Network Zones
Select a **Domain** above. The left panel lists RDS license servers for that domain (MSSQL). The right panel resolves each server IP to its **network zone** (MySQL, subnet/IP containment). The bottom panel joins both on the exact IP address.

**Before use — replace placeholders:**
- MSSQL: `dbo.RdsLicenseServers` (`Domain`, `ServerName`, `IpAddress`, `LicenseType`, `Status`)
- MySQL: `network_zones` (`zone_id`, `zone_name`, `ip_or_subnet` — either a single IPv4 or CIDR like `10.1.0.0/16`)

**Limitation:** subnet math is **IPv4 only** (`INET_ATON`). For IPv6 use `INET6_ATON` and 128-bit comparison.

panels.title: RDS License Servers — Domain: $domain
panels.description: Source: RDS license DB (MSSQL). Filtered by the selected domain(s).

targets.rawSql: SELECT Domain, ServerName AS rds_server, IpAddress AS ip_address, LicenseType, Status FROM dbo.RdsLicenseServers WHERE Domain IN (${domain:singlequote}) ORDER BY ServerName

panels.title: Network Zone Resolution (by IP / subnet)
panels.description: Source: network-zone DB (MySQL). Resolves each RDS server IP (passed via the hidden $rds_ip variable) to a zone using exact-IP match or CIDR containment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT jt.ip AS ip_address, z.zone_id AS zone_id, z.zone_name AS zone_name, z.ip_or_subnet AS matched_entry FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('["', REPLACE('${rds_ip:csv}', ',', '","'), '"]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(45) PATH '$')) AS jt JOIN network_zones z ON ((LOCATE('/', z.ip_or_subnet) = 0 AND z.ip_or_subnet = jt.ip) OR (LOCATE('/', z.ip_or_subnet) > 0 AND (INET_ATON(jt.ip) >> (32 - CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(z.ip_or_subnet, '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED))) = (INET_ATON(SUBSTRING_INDEX(z.ip_or_subnet, '/', 1)) >> (32 - CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(z.ip_or_subnet, '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED))))) ORDER BY jt.ip

panels.title: RDS Server → Network Zone (joined by IP)
panels.description: Mixed datasource. MSSQL RDS rows joined to MySQL zone rows on the exact ip_address column (outer join).

targets.rawSql: SELECT Domain, ServerName AS rds_server, IpAddress AS ip_address, LicenseType, Status FROM dbo.RdsLicenseServers WHERE Domain IN (${domain:singlequote})

SELECT jt.ip AS ip_address, z.zone_id AS zone_id, z.zone_name AS zone_name FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('["', REPLACE('${rds_ip:csv}', ',', '","'), '"]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(45) PATH '$')) AS jt JOIN network_zones z ON ((LOCATE('/', z.ip_or_subnet) = 0 AND z.ip_or_subnet = jt.ip) OR (LOCATE('/', z.ip_or_subnet) > 0 AND (INET_ATON(jt.ip) >> (32 - CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(z.ip_or_subnet, '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED))) = (INET_ATON(SUBSTRING_INDEX(z.ip_or_subnet, '/', 1)) >> (32 - CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(z.ip_or_subnet, '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED))))))
